Distributed opposing slip creates torque, shared slip translates; oriented-body SAT detects an obstacle crossing an edge without containing a corner.

Side geometry contacts center an offset peg and create yaw torque; actual pose differs from the spring command.

Dead-zone delays output engagement while separate motor/output inertia preserves motion after torque release.

Solvent flow conserves total water and each local salt mass; counterpressure reverses the concentration/head-driven direction.
